model.description: Optional change model name or sys_id, see list_change_models. Models define the states and the approvals the change goes through.

template_id.description: sys_id of a standard change template. Required for type standard. Descriptions and plans cannot be set on standard changes.

implementation_plan.description: How the change will be carried out. Normal changes usually need it before they can be scheduled.

test_plan.description: How the change will be verified.

fields.description: Other change fields keyed by column name, for example {"justification": "...", "risk_impact_analysis": "...", "cmdb_ci": "<ci sys_id>", "assignment_group": "<group sys_id>", "start_date": "2026-10-20 10:00:00", "end_date": "2026-10-20 11:00:00"}.
